relevance.rationale: Derives the Standard Model gauge group in its Z_6 global form as the intersection of two maximal-rank subgroups of the compact automorphism group of the exceptional Jordan algebra, using Borel-de Siebenthal theory (eq. 1.4 = eq. 4.4). prose:sm-open-problems states in its status table that the Z_6 global form of G_SM is 'doubly grounded: representation-kernel condition (Baez-Huerta) and geometric F_4-stabilizer derivation (Dubois-Violette-Todorov) agree' -- and that second grounding is uncited in the corpus. The two entries that exist, dubois-violette2016 and dubois-violette-todorov2018, are themselves bib orphans cited from no block, and neither is this Borel-de Siebenthal F_4 derivation. So the corpus names this derivation by author and uses it in the Z_6 compatibility battery without a source. Core: the claim is load-bearing for conj:sm-hypercharge-invariant's battery and this document is the derivation being invoked.

keyResults.statement: The intersection of the maximal-rank subgroups Spin(9) and SU(3)xSU(3)/Z_3 inside the compact automorphism group of the exceptional Jordan algebra is S[U(2)xU(3)] = (SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1))/Z_6, i.e. the Standard Model gauge group in its Z_6 global form.
keyResults.useForFolio: Sources the 'geometric F_4-stabilizer derivation' half of the Z_6 grounding claimed in prose:sm-open-problems and used as the battery condition tau/3 + w/2 + Y/2 in Z for conj:sm-hypercharge-invariant.

keyResults.statement: The analogous intersections inside the compact forms of the structure and conformal groups of the same Jordan algebra give S[U(2)xU(2)xU(3)] and S[U(2)xU(3)xU(3)].
keyResults.useForFolio: Gives the concrete extension candidates a Z_6-grounded framework would have to rule out; useful for the 'a completed derivation would have to predict Gamma' remark in sm-gauge-truncation.

proposedActions.rationale: No ref() entry. Distinct from the existing dubois-violette-todorov2018 entry, which is a different paper in the same programme.
The Z_6 row of prose:sm-open-problems attributes a derivation to named authors with no citation; this is that derivation.
conj:sm-hypercharge-invariant's Z_6 compatibility battery cites only baez-huerta2010 (the representation-kernel route); the geometric route the corpus claims agrees with it is unsourced there.
